d: In today’s episode of The Lallantop’s ‘Guest in Newsroom’, Editor Saurabh Dwivedi hosts a well-known American psychoanalyst and poet Salman Akhtar. He is the son of the renowned Urdu poet Jan Nisar Akhtar and brother of lyricist Javed Akhtar. As a poet, Salman has published around nine volumes of poetry in English and Urdu each. During the conversation with The Lallantop team, Salman Akhtar talks about books, poetry, psychoanalysis and meanings associated with different types of dreams. Apart from all this, Salman Akhtar also talks about his personal life while sharing about his attachment…
